# UI Encyclopedia

## Screen Types

### Main Menu

- New Game
- Continue
- Settings
- Exit

### In-Game HUD

| Panel | Position | Keys |
|-------|----------|------|
| Health/Energy | Top-left | auto |
| Minimap | Top-right | Tab |
| Quests | Right | Q |
| Inventory | Bottom | E |
| Skills | Bottom | 1-5 |
| Chat | Bottom-left | Enter |

### Dialog Panels

- Dialogue (center)
- Shop (modal)
- Quest Details (modal)
- Crafting (modal)
- Settings (fullscreen)

## UI States

```ts
type UIState = 
  | 'hidden'
  | 'hud'
  | 'menu'
  | 'dialogue'
  | 'inventory'
  | 'paused';
```

## Responsive Design

| Breakpoint | Width | Layout |
|-----------|-------|--------|
| Mobile | < 640px | single column |
| Tablet | 640-1024 | compact |
| Desktop | > 1024 | full |

## Accessibility

- Keyboard navigation
- Screen reader support
- High contrast mode
- Reduced motion

## Color Scheme

```css
:root {
  --bg-primary: #0B0C10;
  --bg-secondary: #1F2833;
  --text-primary: #E0E0E0;
  --text-secondary: #9CA3AF;
  --accent: #66FCF1;
  --accent-dim: #45A29E;
  --success: #10B981;
  --warning: #F59E0B;
  --error: #EF4444;
```

## Typography

- Headings: Exo 2
- Body: Inter
- Monospace: JetBrains Mono
